beats.action: The Shiba Inu lies on its belly on the moving treadmill belt with front paws hooking over the front bar as its hindquarters slide backward, while the French Bulldog trots forward in the background.
The Shiba Inu loses its grip and tumbles off the rear of the belt onto the carpet, while the French Bulldog trots up beside the treadmill.
The Shiba Inu rolls onto its back on the carpet with paws in the air, while the French Bulldog inspects the rear edge of the moving belt.
The Shiba Inu wiggles playfully on its back beside a gym bench, while the French Bulldog crouches to pounce onto the running treadmill.
The French Bulldog leaps all four paws forward onto the fast-moving belt as the Shiba Inu watches from the floor.
The moving belt sweeps the French Bulldog's paws backward, causing it to slide helplessly toward the end.
The French Bulldog is thrown off the back of the belt, crashing onto its side directly on top of the Shiba Inu's flank.
The French Bulldog tumbles onto its back beside the Shiba Inu, shaking its head, while the Shiba Inu rolls slightly under its weight.
The French Bulldog sits up awkwardly on its haunches rubbing its shoulder against the floor, while the Shiba Inu lies beside it.
The French Bulldog rests seated next to the treadmill base looking dazed, beside the resting Shiba Inu.
Both dogs lie on the gray gym carpet side by side recovering from the impact.
